fact: The Bureau des Normes de Madagascar (BNM), the national standards body (Organisme National de Normalisation), was created by decree no. 98-944 of 4 November 1998 and is now governed by decree no. 2014-1570 of 30 September 2014; the document names no information technology or data standard.

The UNDP Digital Readiness Assessment states that Madagascar has a national standards body, the Bureau des Normes de Madagascar, a correspondent member of ISO, and that public information shows no specific programme on AI or data-governance standards; the report gives no date for the body's creation, so its published date is used.
